observations.why: Switching databases for a 10x performance gain appeals to novelty and achievement simultaneously — embracing a new technology for measurable competitive advantage.
The migration arrow frames the move as directional change toward a new technology, appealing to openness-to-change.
Quantifying a 10x performance gain appeals to achievement and mastery — measurable capability improvement as the good.
Setting a concrete timeline appeals to stability and planning — pinning the change to a scheduled quarter signals orderly process over disruption.
